lastAction: Implemented Phase 5 DOX Writer (Layer 4) and integrated into CLI/TUI; all 6 gates pass; full test suite green.
nextAction: Phase 5 accepted. Proceed to Phase 6 when ready.

5.1.command: npx tsx src/cli.ts ingest test-wiki && cat wikis/test-wiki/index.md
5.1.expected: A markdown index with title, description, and links to entities/, topics/, documents/, and sources/.

deviations: The DOX Writer is fully deterministic (no LLM calls). Descriptions are template-based from folder names rather than synthesized from page content, satisfying the $0 budget requirement.
The implementation accepts a workspace option in writeDoxContracts so tests can run hermetically against temp directories; the phase doc signature omits this option.

Link checker was enhanced in Phase 4 with folder-index and root-index fallback mappings so DOX-generated wikilinks like [[Executives]] resolve to executives/index.md and [[Test Wiki]] resolves to the root index.md.

Gate 5.6 uses an injected extractChunkFn to re-run ingest with extract: true without live LLM calls, keeping the phase budget at $0. The gate's pass criterion (index.md is regenerated and reflects new pages) is unchanged.
tree-browser.tsx was extended with optional rootName, excludeFolders, and excludeFiles props to support the wiki-root DOX browser; the original entity/topic browser behavior is preserved.
